headline.purpose: Single centered page heading; Arabic heading line-height is 1.5.

motion.name: sg-duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button background transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Four section links with stable medium weight across current-page states.
components.html: HomeProjectsBlogsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem);font-family:var(--sg-font-sans,"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif);font-size:var(--sg-font-size-md,1rem);line-height:var(--sg-line-height,1.65);}.ds-nav a{font-weight:500;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-block-size:var(--sg-control-height,2.75rem);padding:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem) var(--sg-space-3,.75rem);border-radius:var(--sg-radius-sm,4px);text-decoration:none;color:var(--sg-text-muted,#606774);}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--sg-surface-muted,#EEEFEB);color:var(--sg-text,#262D3B);}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--sg-primary,#4C638B);background:var(--sg-primary-soft,#E9EEF6);}.ds-nav:lang(ar){font-family:var(--sg-font-arabic,"IBM Plex Sans Arabic","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif);line-height:var(--sg-line-height-ar,1.9);}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-nav{gap:var(--sg-space-1,.25rem);}}.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sg-focus,#4C638B);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Language control
components.description: Quiet link to the equivalent section in the other locale.
components.html: العربية
components.css: .ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem);min-block-size:var(--sg-control-height,2.75rem);padding:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem) var(--sg-space-4,1rem);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--sg-radius-sm,4px);background:transparent;color:var(--sg-primary,#4C638B);font-family:var(--sg-font-sans,"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif);font-size:var(--sg-font-size-md,1rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--sg-duration-fast,140ms) var(--sg-ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));}.ds-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--sg-surface-muted,#EEEFEB);}.ds-quiet:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--sg-primary-active,#304567);}.ds-quiet:lang(ar){font-family:var(--sg-font-arabic,"IBM Plex Sans Arabic","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif);}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sg-focus,#4C638B);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-quiet{transition:none;}}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-quiet{padding-inline:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem);}}

components.name: Theme control
components.description: Square quiet button; snippet shows the light-theme icon. Switching requires the site preference script.
components.html: <button class="ds-quiet ds-theme" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.9 13.2A9 9 0 0 1 10.8 3.1 9 9 0 1 0 20.9 13.2Z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem);min-block-size:var(--sg-control-height,2.75rem);padding:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem) var(--sg-space-4,1rem);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--sg-radius-sm,4px);background:transparent;color:var(--sg-primary,#4C638B);font-family:var(--sg-font-sans,"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif);font-size:var(--sg-font-size-md,1rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--sg-duration-fast,140ms) var(--sg-ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));}.ds-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--sg-surface-muted,#EEEFEB);}.ds-quiet:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--sg-primary-active,#304567);}.ds-quiet:lang(ar){font-family:var(--sg-font-arabic,"IBM Plex Sans Arabic","IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif);}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sg-focus,#4C638B);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-quiet{transition:none;}}.ds-theme{inline-size:var(--sg-control-height,2.75rem);padding:var(--sg-space-2,.5rem);}.ds-theme svg{flex-shrink:0;}

narrative.overview: The supplied style kit is the visual authority. This record captures its implemented subset: bilingual typography, semantic light and dark colors, quiet controls, and section navigation. The source CSS in `styling_guide/kit/` and `src/styles/global.css` remains authoritative when this snapshot differs.
dos: Do reuse the supplied kit's semantic variables and local fonts.
Do preserve equivalent English and Arabic layouts, labels, and focus visibility.
donts: Don't modify the supplied style kit to create a competing token system.
Don't treat unused kit components or colors as implemented site patterns.
